boot_epoch_disposition: A McKernel-boot-scoped epoch is sufficient only if all previous-boot readers, interrupt deliveries and external references drain before memory or identity reuse. Checked counters never reuse issued identities and reject exhaustion within the boot.
host_drain_findings: smp_ihk_os_shutdown ignores reset results while deassigning CPUs and a later unmap assignment overwrites ret before memory reclamation
smp_ihk_destroy_os frees its object without a demonstrated late-reader drain
handler unregister deletes a list node while smp_ihk_irq_call_handlers traverses the list; caller-level reader protection is unverified

conditional_sequence.name: lifetime foundation
private_types: ShootdownRecord { serial, immutable_addresses, targets, acknowledged, readers, phase }
conditional_sequence.requirements: Create boot ownership before concurrent admission; publish and retire descriptor generations under the hash lock; defer destruction through pins; publish immutable shootdown state before delivery; acknowledge each target once; retain timed-out slot/storage through reader drain; fail registration before mutation.

conditional_sequence.name: clear capture and delayed release
conditional_sequence.private_type: ClearJournal { removed_entries, retained_pages, table_pages, cursor, outcome }
conditional_sequence.requirements: Capture descriptors before hash removal; distinguish partial mutation from acknowledged invalidation; release no backing or child table on unknown completion; claim rollback only after restoring every mutation.

conditional_sequence.name: XPMEM and VM handoff
conditional_sequence.requirements: Normalize VM-range then attachment lock order; register before unpin/split; retain VA exclusion without holding locks across shootdown; transfer at VM final release before callbacks/destruction.

conditional_sequence.name: quarantine, recovery and OS drain
conditional_sequence.private_type: QuarantineRecord { reason, cursor, retry_budget, lease, retained_resources }
conditional_sequence.requirements: Persist bounded recovery progress; require proven CPU, IRQ and worker quiescence before host reclamation; retain resources on drain failure.
